episodes.title: Le journal du matin, mercredi 21 octobre
episodes.headline_en: New curfews have been decreed for the night of Wednesday to Thursday in certain sectors of several cities, including Paris and Lyon, after the violence of 17 October
summary_en: New curfews have been decreed for the night of Wednesday to Thursday in certain sectors of several cities, including Paris and Lyon, after the violence of 17 October
Russian President Vladimir Putin announced on Wednesday the release of an American held in Russia and accused of having served as a mercenary for Ukraine
France Televisions: a new curfew has been decreed for the night of Wednesday to Thursday in certain sectors of Paris such as Place de la Republique

episodes.title: Le sport, mercredi 21 octobre
episodes.headline_en: Football: Rennes travel to Juventus in Turin on Thursday 22 October for the third round of the Europa League, kick-off 6.45pm
summary_en: Football: Rennes travel to Juventus in Turin on Thursday 22 October for the third round of the Europa League, kick-off 6.45pm
Rennes will be without striker Estéban Lepaul at Juventus, the rest of the squad is available

episodes.title: La météo, mercredi 21 octobre
episodes.headline_en: Marseille: overcast, 13 to 18 degrees, wind up to 33 kilometres an hour
summary_en: Marseille: overcast, 13 to 18 degrees, wind up to 33 kilometres an hour
Bordeaux: light rain, 12 to 17 degrees, wind up to 24 kilometres an hour
